prior_terminal_row.title: News Ltd. Takes a 40% Stake in the News of the World After Maxwell Bid
prior_terminal_row.description_short: News Ltd. Takes a 40% Stake in the News of the World After Maxwell Bid
prior_terminal_row.description_medium: The Guardian’s 1968 archive reports that Rupert Murdoch’s News Ltd. was to take a 40% stake in the News of the World after Robert Maxwell’s Pergamon Press failed in a takeover bid. Murdoch was to become joint managing director. The linked report documents this British newspaper transaction, but it does not establish any connection to Donald Trump.
prior_terminal_row.description_long: A Guardian archive report dated October 25, 1968, said effective control of the News of the World was passing to the Australian newspaper company News Ltd. The report described a deal intended to defeat a takeover bid by Pergamon Press, the publishing group headed by Robert Maxwell. Under the announced arrangement, News Ltd. was to take a 40% stake in the Sunday newspaper, which the article described as Britain’s largest-circulation Sunday paper. Rupert Murdoch, News Ltd.’s chairman, was to become joint managing director alongside the paper’s existing chairman, Sir William Carr. The article documents the proposed ownership transaction and management change. It does not mention Donald Trump or establish why this historical newspaper event belongs in a Trump-related record. The event can be described from the Guardian report, but the record still needs evidence of a direct Trump connection or confirmation that it should be retained as an unrelated historical item.

title: TrumpFile Post Claims Trump Never Planned to Win the November 2024 Election

prior_terminal_row.title: TrumpFile Post Claims Trump Never Planned to Win the November 2024 Election
prior_terminal_row.description_short: TrumpFile Post Claims Trump Never Planned to Win the November 2024 Election
prior_terminal_row.description_medium: An August 2024 TrumpFile post asserted that Donald Trump never planned to win the November election, but the supplied synopsis includes no supporting quotation. A later Axios report described campaign contingency planning for either outcome and said Trump expected to win while acknowledging he could lose. That later report does not establish his private intent.
prior_terminal_row.description_long: The title of an August 2024 TrumpFile post asserted that Donald Trump never intended to win the November election, but the supplied synopsis provides no quotation or evidence supporting that conclusion. The linked TrumpFile page was inaccessible in the source pass. A separate Axios report published on November 4 described a campaign email planning for both possible outcomes, including winding down payroll if Trump lost and moving some staff into transition or inauguration work if he won. Axios also reported that Trump expected to win while privately acknowledging that he could lose. Contingency planning for either outcome does not show that a campaign lacked an intention to win, and the Axios report postdates the August post.
